complete_computation_scope: Full validation/plan/weight construction + partialDot + kernel for all physical roots; excludes fixture/public graph creation, initial defer generation and cryptographic sumchecks/openings. Sparse/reuse tests separately timed and excluded from combined.
RSS_scope: Paired same-process cumulative RSS; includes both plans and native public graph; not independent old/new peak.
allocation_scope: Calling-thread ordinary C++ new; excludes C malloc/aligned allocations/worker allocations, stack scratch, OS page cache and anonymous file bytes.
memory_cache_limit: Unchanged 16MiB ordinary/256MiB Full12. File cap4x map budget; 4096-run read/build scratch bound.
native_sample: 24 actual highest fragmented declarations in original relative order; 45 true Full12 physical roots; deterministic numeric values; no private Witness. Full12 acceptance is a separate gated run.
